Class RuleDTO

java.lang.Object
marius.server.data.dto.RuleDTO
public class RuleDTO extends Object
Represents a single security rule returned by the agent when the getSystemRules route is called.

Contains the rule's name, description, status, and the IPv4 address of the agent.
